settings.heading: Disc Trac helical LSD
settings.text: Ultimate traction from a forged billet, 7-helical-gear limited slip differential — engineered for the track and hardened up to 45–50 HRC.

settings.alt: Disc Trac Helical LSD — forged billet, 7 helical gears, hardened 45–50 HRC

settings.text: The Disc Trac helical LSD is engineered using cutting-edge technology to deliver superior performance on the track. Designed with a 7-helical gear system, it ensures smooth, seamless power transfer to both wheels, maximizing traction and stability. The patented power transfer mechanism reduces power loss, allowing drivers to maintain speed and control through corners. Precision-machined from forged billet 2MNCR5 material, it is built to withstand extreme forces while providing long-lasting reliability and performance.

settings.heading: Three parts, one seamless unit
settings.text: Every Disc Trac is designed around adjustability, strength and smooth engagement.

settings.title: Customizable disc preload
settings.text: A variable disc preload system lets you fine-tune how aggressively the diff engages — tighter for high-speed grip, looser for smoother transitions — so the LSD adapts to your driving style and track conditions.

settings.title: Billet external case
settings.text: Precision CNC-machined from high-grade billet for superior heat dissipation and structural integrity. It handles high torque loads without deformation and drops into a range of differential housings for easy installation.

settings.title: 7-helical gear internals
settings.text: The 7-helical gear setup gives progressive, smooth engagement with no harsh locking. Paired with strategic friction surfaces for a balanced 50/50 torque split — quiet, efficient and low-maintenance versus clutch-type LSDs.

settings.heading: Built to a spec, not a price
settings.text: Race-grade materials and tolerances in every unit.

settings.label: Maintenance
settings.value: Minimal — no clutch packs to service

settings.heading: Request a Disc Trac quote
settings.text: Tell us your vehicle, differential and spline count and we'll come back with pricing and lead time. Bulk orders welcome.
